section_summary.extract_value: This Introduction describes a single study that examines the psychometric properties of the 13-item Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) with Malaysian women and aims to verify its unidimensionality using confirmatory factor analysis. The section also states an aim to examine ethnic differences in body appreciation between Malaysian Chinese and Malay women.
section_summary.evidence_source: "To overcome this dearth in the literature, the present study examines the psychometric properties of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS ...), a 13-item scale measuring aspects of positive body image, with Malaysian women." and "Using confirmatory factor analysis (CFA), therefore, we sought to verify the unidimensionality of the BAS in a sample of Malaysian women. An additional aim of this study was to examine ethnic differences in body appreciation among Malaysian Chinese and Malays, the two major ethnic groups in the study site."
